english.title: Fail to comply with section 17(1) requirement in social problem area caused by misuse of drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[doctor practising]_
(B)_[pharmacist practising]_
(C)_[person carrying on a retail pharmacy business within the meaning of the Medicines Act 1968 at premises situated]_

in or in the vicinity of **(..SPECIFY AREA..), an area where it appeared to the Secretary of State that there existed a social problem caused by the extensive misuse of dangerous or otherwise harmful drugs, without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement to which you were subject by virtue of section 17(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17(1) and (3) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
